ideas.name: Startup Mentor Match
ideas.problem: Founders often struggle to find experienced mentors who can provide targeted advice. This app connects early-stage startups with seasoned mentors based on industry, stage, and specific challenges.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B, tiered subscriptions for startups and mentors (e.g., $49/month for basic founder access, premium tiers for featured mentors).

ideas.name: Local Business Trust Builder
ideas.problem: Small local businesses struggle to build trust and transparency with consumers, especially in markets dominated by large players. This app helps verify local businesses and share verified positive customer experiences.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B for businesses ($19/month for verification and profile features), with optional consumer-facing premium features for early access to deals.
